lines.en: : Hey, everybody! Sorry I’m late!

: That aside, can we talk about how Osako just radiates bottom energy for a second?
: You’d think that being a fucking martial arts god or whatever that she might feel a little more...I don’t know, powerful when it comes to this stuff?
: I think things work well this way and I wouldn’t change their dynamic at all.
: Yeah, but you’re pitching a tent the size of Fujisan right now. You’d be happy with anything.
: Wakana...mmf...Wakana~
: I love you...
: And I you.
: What’s...gotten into you all of a sudden?...
: It’s hard to say, my kitten.
: But perhaps I could show you?
: Show...me?...
: But...we’re-
: I know you’ve all been anxiously awaiting her arrival, but I’m afraid that I will be whisking this one away for a short while.
: Please continue on with your game without paying much mind to what the two of us are doing.
: Oh...and best of luck, Arakawa.

: I think I’m slightly above doing something like that, Imani. Just slightly, though.
: Really? Cause I’ve been wrong before, but I'm gonna agree with Rika. I felt some mad tension right there.
: Between those two? Yes. Between anyone else, I don’t think so.
: Dude, did you see the way she smirked at you? Because I’ll be damned if that wasn’t a “Hahah, look what you can’t have” smirk.

: Daughter?...
: How...

: And as your master...it’s up to me to give you more...so you don’t go crazy...

: You know what, my kitten?
: What if I let you off with just a warning this time?
: I did miss you, after all...
: And your tardiness was unintentional...

: I do like it when you squirm.
